title: Embiggen cards have a normal version and an Embiggened version, in every text and screen
notes: Issue #1175 (part of #1173): a card with two prices is an embiggen card, played as its normal version at the cheaper price or as its Embiggened version at its Embiggened cost (R1175000). The embiggen cards' texts label that version "Embiggened (N): ..." where R366 wrote "Paid (N): ...", on both faces, in English and Chinese ("加码(N)："). Wording only: no number, keyword, script or rule changes. Eight cards say it; two were already claimed by a pending patch when this one was written, and a card ships in one patch, so their wording ships under that patch's claim: core-056 under v0.3.10 and meditative-081 under v0.3.8. This note's player line still describes them.

player.title: Embiggened cards
text: Cards with two prices now say Embiggened (N) for their dearer version, and the cheaper one is their normal version. Nothing plays differently.
